Failure sirf naya start karne ka opportunity hai.
Hazaar meel ki yatra bhi ek hi kadam se shuru hoti hai.
Tum occasion tak nahi uthte; tum apne level pe girte ho.
Discontent hi progress ka pehla step hai.
Jo duniya badalne ki himmat rakhte hain, wahi badalte hain.
Dhanyavad dena seekho.
"Jo baar-baar repeat karte, mind usi ko believe karta."
"Chup chaap mehnat; success shor machayegi."
Apna future banao.
Din mat gino, dinon ko count karo.
Mind jab stretch hota hai, purani limits me wapas nahi aata.
Aage ja rahe ho ya peeche—tum move kar rahe ho.
